name: Download selling tool with tax help and AI support

mentions.name: Download selling tool with tax help and AI support
mentions.description: A tool for selling digital downloads in which sellers act as their own merchant and receive built-in tax help and AI support; positioned as much cheaper than typical download-selling platforms and largely free of sales tax.
mentions.problem: Existing download-selling platforms ('the usual suspects') are more expensive and involve sales tax.
mentions.source_excerpt: Download selling tool where you act as your own seller but get tax help and AI support. Much cheaper than the usual suspects and no sales tax for the most part.

evidence.value: Download selling tool where you act as your own seller but get tax help and AI support. Much cheaper than the usual suspects and no sales tax for the most part.
